intro: He kaiwhakawhanake tauhou ahau. Ka whakahaere ahau i te ratonga manaaki tūmau ASHIKA Network me te rārangi tūmau Minecraft SABALISU, ā, ka hanga ahau i te pūmanawa tūmau Minecraft Storia.
about: He tauhou tonu ahau, engari ka tuhi waehere ahau ia rā, ā, ka pai ake haere
Ka tuhi ahau i te **Python**, te **Node.js** me te **C#**
Ka whakahaere ahau i tāku ake ratonga manaaki tūmau
Nau mai ngā pātai mō aku ratonga, mō te hangarau rānei: mihi mai noa i runga Discord
can_write: Ngā mea ka taea e au te tuhi (tae atu ki te waehere pōraruraru)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: he tūmau mai i te 30 yen ia marama
anw_p:
He ratonga manaaki mō te hunga e hiahia ana ki te whakahaere tūmau, engari kāore e taea te whakapau moni nui.
Tīmata iti, **mai i te 30 yen noa iho ia marama**.
sab_p:
Tāpirihia tō tūmau Minecraft ki te rārangi, ka kimi i ētahi tāngata hei tākaro ki reira.
He whai hua mō ngā kaitākaro e kimi ana i tētahi tūmau, me ngā rangatira e hiahia ana ki te whakatairanga i ō rātou.
storia_t: Storia: he pūmanawa tūmau mō ngā tūmau Minecraft nunui
storia_p: He peka puna tuwhera o Folia mō Minecraft 26.2. Mā te **Storia Cluster**, ka taea e tētahi ao kotahi te rere i runga i ētahi tūmau i te wā kotahi, ā, ka neke ngā kaitākaro i waenga i a rātou kāore he mata uta.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: kotahi te ao e tiritiria ana e ētahi tūmau, he mea whakamuna ngā hononga i waenganui
**Relay tāpiri**: ka pupuri te relay tuarua i tētahi tārua ora, ā, ka riro i a ia mēnā ka ngaro te tuatahi
**Hōputu Linear**: tata ki te haurua o te wāhi kōpae e pau ana i te ao
**Ao RAM**, **Tick Guard**, he API mono mō ngā raraunga tiritiri, me ētahi atu
welcome: Nau mai ki ngā mea katoa!
